name: Jewelry Bonney
text:
[On Play] If your Leader has the {Supernovas} type, draw 2 cards and play up to 2 Character cards with 2000 power or less from your hand.
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Leader or Characters with 6000 power or more −1000 power until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.
notes: Only the draw and play need a {Supernovas} Leader.

name: Doll
text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 2 {Navy} type cards with a cost of 2 or more and add them to your hand, then place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, trash 1 card from your hand.

name: Baby 5
text:
[On Play] You may reveal 2 Event cards from your hand: Draw 2 cards.
[On K.O.] Play up to 1 Character card with 6000 power or less from your hand rested.

name: Belo Betty
text:
[On Play] Up to 3 of your Characters with both the {Revolutionary Army} type and a [Trigger] gain +2000 power during this turn.
[Activate: Main] You may trash this Character: Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −2000 power during this turn.

name: Miss Buckingham Stussy
text:
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may add 1 card from the top of your Life cards to your hand: Choose one:
• Give up to 1 Character +3000 power during this turn.
• Give up to 1 Character −4000 power during this turn.

options.label: Give up to 1 Character +3000 power during this turn
Give up to 1 Character −4000 power during this turn

name: Monet
text:
[On Play] You may reveal a total of 3 Event or {Punk Hazard} type cards from your hand: Draw 1 card.
[End of Your Turn] This Character gains +5000 power until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.

name: Luffy, Now's Your Chance
types: The Seven Warlords of the Sea
text:
[Main] You may give 1 active DON!! card to 1 of your Leader and reveal 2 red Event cards from your hand: Give up to 1 of your opponent's rested Characters −7000 power during this turn.
[Counter] If you have no Characters with a cost of 5 or more, up to 1 of your Leader or up to 1 of your Characters gains +4000 power during this battle.
notes: The DON!! from the cost can go to any of your cards, not only the Leader.

name: Fight and Die with Me!!!
text:
[Main] All of your Characters with 4000 base power or less gain +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.
[Counter] Your Leader gains +3000 power during this battle.

name: Nico Robin
text:
[Once Per Turn] When one of your Characters with the <Wisdom> attribute and without [Blocker] is K.O.'d, add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Set up to 1 of your Characters with the <Wisdom> attribute and 6000 power or less as active.

name: Otohime
text: [On Play] If your Leader is [Shirahoshi], you may turn 1 card from the top of your Life cards face-down: Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 5 or less.

name: Camie
text: [On Play] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 6 or less.

name: Shirley
text: [On Your Opponent's Attack] [Once Per Turn] You may rest 1 of your DON!! cards: Your {Fish-Man} or {Merfolk} type Leader gains +2000 power during this battle.

name: Shirahoshi
text:
[On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to a total of 2 [Megalo] or {Neptunian} type cards and add them to your hand. Then, trash the rest.
[Activate: Main] You may rest this Character: Up to 1 of your {Neptunian} type Characters with 6000 power or less gains [Rush] during this turn.

name: Nico Robin
text: [Your Turn] [On Play] Play up to 1 Character card with a cost of 5 or less and the <Wisdom> attribute from your hand.
trigger: [Trigger] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 6 or less.

name: Mermaid Cafe Dancers
text: [On Your Opponent's Attack] You may rest 1 of your DON!! cards and trash this Character: Your {Fish-Man} or {Merfolk} type Leader gains +4000 power during this battle.

name: Rebecca
text: [On Play] Up to 1 of your opponent's rested Characters with a cost of 6 or less will not become active in your opponent's next Refresh Phase.

name: I Choose to Open This Country to the World!! I Want to Fight on Your Side!!!
text: [Counter] You may rest 1 of your cards: Up to 1 of your {Land of Wano} type Leader or Characters gains +4000 power during this battle.
trigger: [Trigger] If your opponent has 3 or less Life cards, play up to 1 {Land of Wano} type Character card with 6000 power or less from your hand.

name: My name is Shirahoshi!!
text: [Main] You may rest your Leader [Shirahoshi]: Draw 2 cards.

name: Alvida
text:
[On Play] Draw 2 cards and play up to 1 {Cross Guild} type Character card with a cost of 8 or less from your hand. Then, you cannot play Character cards during this turn.
[When Attacking] Negate the effect of up to 1 of your opponent's Characters during this turn.

name: Octopako
text: [On K.O.] Draw 2 cards.

name: Osome
text: [On Play] You may trash 2 Events from your hand: Draw 3 cards.

name: Little Sadi
text:
If your Leader has the {Impel Down} type, this Character gains [Blocker] and +2 cost.
(After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

name: Domino
text: [On Play] Look at 3 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Impel Down} type card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Hibari
text: [On Play] Draw 3 cards and trash 2 cards from your hand. Then, place up to 1 Character with a cost of 2 or less at the bottom of the owner's deck.

name: Boa Hancock
types: The Seven Warlords of the Sea
text: [On Play] If your opponent has 9 or more cards in their hand, they trash 4 cards from their hand.

name: Kimono Sleeve Cage
text: [Main] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Negate the effect of up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 6 or less during this turn, and return it to the owner's hand.
trigger: [Trigger] Draw 2 cards and trash 1 card from your hand.

name: Take Care, Everybody. ♡
text:
[Main] If your Leader is [Nami], return up to 1 Character with a cost of 5 or less to the owner's hand.
[Counter] Draw 1 card, and up to 1 of your Leader or Characters gains +1000 power during this turn.

name: Vinsmoke Reiju
text:
[On Play] DON!! −1: If your Leader has the {The Vinsmoke Family} type, trash 10 cards from the top of your deck.
[Activate: Main] You may trash this Character: If your opponent has a Character with 8000 base power or more, add up to 4 DON!! cards as active from your DON!! deck.

name: Nico Robin
text: [On Play] If your Leader has the {Straw Hat Crew} type and the number of DON!! cards on your field is at least 6 less than the number on your opponent's field, draw 3 cards and trash 2 cards from your hand. Then, add up to 4 DON!! cards as rested from your DON!! deck.

name: Sugar
text: [On Play] DON!! −2: If you have 7 or more DON!! cards on your field, give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −4000 power during this turn.

name: Speed
text: [On Play] DON!! −1: Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 2 {SMILE} type cards and add them to your hand, then place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, play up to 2 {SMILE} type Character cards with 5000 power or less from your hand.

name: Tsuru
text: [On Play] If your Leader has the {Navy} type, draw 1 card, and add up to 1 DON!! card as rested from your DON!! deck.

name: Black Maria
text: [On Play] Look at 3 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Animal Kingdom Pirates} type card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Russian
text: [On Play] Up to 1 of your [Senor Pink] cards gains +3000 power during this turn.

name: Pink Hornet
text:
[Main] DON!! −1: If your Leader has the {The Vinsmoke Family} type, give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −4000 power during this turn.
[Counter] DON!! −1: Your Leader gains +4000 power during this battle.

name: You Need Me, Don't You?!!♡
text:
[Main] You may return 1 of your active DON!! cards to your DON!! deck: If your Leader has the {Donquixote Pirates} type, draw 3 cards and trash 1 card from your hand.
[Counter] Your Leader gains +2000 power during this battle.
notes: The official card list gives no cost for this Event yet.

name: Shinobu
text: [On Play] Draw 2 cards and trash 2 cards from your hand.

name: Perona
text: [On K.O.] K.O. or rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 6 or less.

options.label: K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 6 or less
Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 6 or less

name: Ms. Father's Day
text: [On Play] If your Leader's type includes "Baroque Works" and your opponent has a Character with a cost of 0, give your opponent's Leader −1000 power during this turn.

name: Ms. Monday
text:
[On Play] K.O. up to 1 of your Characters with a type including "Baroque Works".
[On K.O.] Look at 3 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 card with a type including "Baroque Works" and add it to your hand. Then, trash the rest.

name: Yamato
text:
If your opponent has a Character with 8000 base power or more, this Character gains [Blocker] and +3000 power.
[On Your Opponent's Attack]  You may trash 1 card from your hand: If you have 10 or more cards in your trash, your Leader's base power becomes 7000 during this turn.

name: Ripley
text:
This Character gains +12 cost.
[On Play] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Play up to 1 Character card with a cost of 2 or less from your trash.

name: Hedgehog Stinger
text:
[Main] You may rest 1 of your DON!! cards and K.O. 1 of your Characters with a type including "Baroque Works": All of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 0 cannot activate [Blocker] during this turn.
[Counter] Your Leader gains +3000 power during this battle.

name: Special Hollow
text:
[Main] You may K.O. 1 of your {Thriller Bark Pirates} type Characters: Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −3 cost during this turn.
[Counter] You may K.O. 1 of your {Thriller Bark Pirates} type Characters: Up to 1 of your Leader or Characters gains +4000 power during this battle.

name: Atlas
text: [On Play] Look at 4 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 card with the <Wisdom> attribute and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Ahiru
text: [On Play] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost equal to or less than the total of your and your opponent's Life cards.

name: Gloriosa
text: If you would take damage, you may trash this Character instead.
trigger: [Trigger] Draw 2 cards and trash 1 card from your hand.
notes: "Trash this Character instead" prevents the whole damage, including both damage of a Double Attack.

name: Charlotte Praline
text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If your opponent has 9 or more cards in their hand, add up to 1 card from your hand to the top of your Life cards.
trigger: [Trigger] You may trash 1 card from your hand: If you have 2 or less Life cards, play this card.

name: Charlotte Brulee
trigger: [Trigger] Play up to 2 {Big Mom Pirates} type Character cards with 4000 power from your hand.

name: Nami
text: [Your Turn] [On Play] If your Leader has the <Wisdom> attribute, add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.
trigger: [Trigger] You may trash 1 card from your hand: If you have 2 or less Life cards, play this card.

name: Nico Olvia
text: [On Play] You may trash 1 card with a [Trigger] from your hand: If your Leader is [Nico Robin], draw 2 cards.

name: Nojiko
text: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Give up to 1 rested DON!! card to 1 of your Leader or Character cards with the <Special> or <Wisdom> attribute.
trigger: [Trigger] If you have 2 or less Life cards, play up to 1 Character card with 6000 power or less and a [Trigger] from your hand.

name: Charlotte Pudding!!
text: [Main] Draw 1 card, and all of your Characters with 4000 base power and the {Big Mom Pirates} type cannot be K.O.'d in battle until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.
trigger: [Trigger] Draw 1 card, and play up to 1 Character card with 4000 power and a [Trigger] from your hand.

name: Take Care of Lilith!!!
text:
[Main] You may trash 1 of your {Egghead} type Characters with a cost of 5 or more: Add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.
[Counter] You may turn 1 card from the top of your Life cards face-up: Up to 1 of your Leader or Characters gains +4000 power during this battle.

name: Nami
text:
[Once Per Turn] If one of your Characters with 6000 base power or less would be removed from the field by your opponent, you may add 1 card from the top of your Life cards to your hand instead.
[On Play] Play up to 1 red Character card with a cost of 2 or less from your hand.
notes: "By your opponent" is read as by your opponent's effects; K.O.s in battle are not replaced.
